Figure 1: Overview of the proposed training framework. Our tamper detector jointly produces a pixellevel tampering mask, a semantic category label, and a natural-language description of the tampered content. The training framework integrates three components: 1) balanced real-vs-tampered mini-batch sampling, 2) a late-injection mechanism for incorporating Gemini-2.5 during training, and 3) a low-learning-rate adaptation schedule for pixel-level localization.

Table 10: Source composition study: Full and three-source compositions. Each row represents a different three-source training composition built on top of Qwen-Image. #Src. denotes the number of training sources. Per-generator columns report tampered accuracy (%) on each test generator. Avg. (All) denotes the average accuracy across all six generators; Avg. (OOD) denotes the average accuracy across the held-out OOD generators. Bold indicates the best result, and underline indicates the second-best result, both within the three-source composition family.
